verdict.rationale: Apple's docs explicitly detail the M4 Max Media Engine with two video encode engines and two ProRes encode/decode engines, plus hardware-accelerated ray tracing, and cite real-world creator workflows like real-time de-noising in DaVinci Resolve Studio. HEVC/H.264 hardware encode is a longstanding Apple Media Engine feature implied by 'two video encode engines' though AV1 decode specifics aren't separately spelled out. missing for 10: explicit AV1 codec confirmation, independent benchmark corroboration of encode/decode throughput.
